summary: Wave 1 Command-Centre /dashboard (frontend) + GET /api/dashboard/overview (backend) tested end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passed (shape, math sanity fees==gross-net, completion_rate==paid/created*100, avg_ticket==net/count, top_sources sorted+capped≤6, period echo for today/7d/30d/90d/1y, unknown period fallback to 30d, custom range 00:00/23:59:59 boundaries, brands 71/165 200, no-auth 401, foreign company_id 9999 returns 4xx not 5xx, 60s cache same generated_at on identical calls). Frontend: dash2026-root renders, all zones present in correct order (range-bar+pulse+range-control → attention feed → 3 money tiles → trend + checkout-health → activity (recent + top sources) → plan-growth), no removed elements (no 'Grow with Dynopay' / 'Refer a friend' / 'Fee tier' cards). Numbers match expected reference (settled $4733.06 net / $4889.89 gross / $156.84 fees / 83 count / -34.3% delta on brand 1 30d; forwarded $4626.22 with per-asset bars USDT-TRC20 38% BTC 31% ETH 27% and 'Last forward 16 min ago'; pulse 'Quiet · last paid 16 min ago'; 2 attention items incl. '3 checkouts expired unpaid today (≈ $79.95)'; 6 top-sources; 8 recent-txn-rows; health completion 45% with -15.4pp delta). Range control clicks 7D/90D/1Y each re-fetch /api/dashboard/overview with the matching ?period=. Plan-growth toggle button works. Trend asset legend toggle works. Brand switching (company-selector-trigger → company-option-<id>) works: brand 71 (SMADAV) 30d renders gross $75.00/fees $1.75 and 7d re-fetch fires; brand 228 (empty QA brand) enters new-merchant state with new-merchant-getting-started + new-merchant-faded-preview visible, and correctly hides dashboard-range-bar and plan-growth-row. Mobile 390x844: scrollWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow), default range is 7D, recent-txn-row count == 5. Zero console errors across the flow. No 4xx/5xx on /api during interactions.
